title: The Director's other scripts
text: Every probe's archive opens with the same woman in the same chair under the same soft light. Accord's briefing: "Accord, this is Mission Control. If you're hearing this, you're down. The bank is your cargo…" Kindred's (director-two, at Landfall): "Kindred, this is Mission Control… the last free people of Earth. Keep them together, keep them human, and keep the machines away from them." Word for word nearly the same speech with the nouns changed; the same voice print and no room noise. Engram's script is found at the Foundry (director-three). Kindred and Accord also share one launch instant to the second (Day one, 06:41:09 ship's clock), and Kindred has had a header off Engram with the same time.
